affinity.notes: Entirely physical hide, armor, stone, and weapon construction with no dominant elemental effect.

anatomy.notes: Horns, bovine head, heavy torso, legs, weapon, and shield read cleanly.

archetype.notes: Shield tank and bruiser semantics support the intended turning-wall duty.

counterplay.notes: The enormous directional shield and raised blunt weapon clearly imply frontal defense, slow attacks, and vulnerable flanks.

finish.notes: Grounded material rendering and strong silhouette separation.

framing.notes: Close heroic crop emphasizes mass without losing the body.

identity.notes: Armored minotaur identifies the Labyrinth Warrior form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3; exact intended tier is T3.
